apis.catalog: console_catalog/resolve_console/execution_inventory expose the eleven exact coded era profiles, seven Forge generation envelopes and all canonical Dragon hardware/source declarations under dragon_native:<native_id>; source-only, toolchain-adapter, licensed-SDK and historical statuses are preserved. Reference association never grants native binary execution
apis.learning: GameEnvironmentSpec and EpisodeStep declare exact finite numeric observations, available actions, component reward semantics and episode budget
apis.reference: GameLearningEnvironment(target_id,max_steps,gameplay_dialect,tree) reset/step/observe/preview/snapshot/restore runs existing native machines with exact project/source identity
apis.factory: create_game_environment accepts ROM bytes only for the separately declared experimental game_boy runtime and exact generated-grid configs through the generation owner. Native-source profiles without an actual generated config or independently compiled execution bridge reject step admission; unsupported source/target combinations never fall back
apis.simulation: simulate_game executes bounded caller actions with cancellation probes and returns native state/frame identities, actual transition chains, final snapshot and exact measured reward components
apis.thumby: dragon_native:thumby executes the exact existing canonical GAME fresh/_rand/_bound/step numeric gameplay functions through a bounded allowlisted AST module containing only integer constants and those functions. No uploaded code, imports, attributes, unbounded loops, device API or provider is executed. Exact template/module/adapter/Python identities fence replay. Actual health, score, enemy and goal changes supply rewards. Device firmware graphics remain unverified; host preview uses original fixed bitmap bytes at observed positions and declares its limited scope
apis.raster: Additive RasterImage plus render_reference_image and ThreeDMachine.reference_image expose the exact RGB buffer already computed by the existing software rasterizer; existing render_reference_scene/reference_raster return values and algorithms remain unchanged

integrity: Reference snapshots restore by executing the exact recorded seed/actions in a separate environment and comparing all native state, frame, goal and transition identities before replacing receiver state. Source code, tree, task/reward schema and budget are bound to environment identity. JSON duplicate keys, nonfinite values and structural/byte excess fail before native execution.
preview: RGB pixels are captured only when preview is requested, hashed against the existing raster color digest and bound to current native state. Reference command projections identify truncation and never claim fabricated pixel textures, real GPU execution or commercial-console compatibility.
limitations: Reference machines execute fixed coded worlds plus bounded tuning; arbitrary uploaded scenes/Python are not executed
Rewards are declared local task utilities, not evidence of general game mastery
ROM visual-change rewards are exploration metrics, not game-success measurements
GB-20 is biomechanical range of motion, unrelated to Game Boy hardware
No automated tests are written or run in this user-directed implementation session; compatibility and acceptance remain unverified
failure: Invalid source/tree/seed/action, unsupported mapper/instruction, foreign snapshot or code identity, exhausted resources and cancelled work fail explicitly without granting promotion authority

studio_game_environment.scope: All registered original-game reference engine sessions execute through existing advanced-session action replay and verified hashed receipts; no added model-provider, renderer or native emulator.
studio_game_environment.learning: Emulator-compatible GameEnvironmentSpec/EpisodeStep reset/step/current_observation/preview/snapshot/restore; local Q policy uses actual runtime state deltas. Registered but unavailable commands remain measured penalized attempts, consume the finite episode budget and leave the accepted engine replay unchanged; later legal commands can continue. Unregistered commands still reject before mutation.
guarantees: deterministic strict scene and action replay
rejected commands do not grant game progress
limitations: Original reference scenes render only actual replayed state; unsupported scene families retain explicitly labelled numeric telemetry. Neither is native hardware output or original commercial-game art/audio.
reward shaping measures declared engine state, not general game design quality
no live production neural weight update
requires operator rights and training admission

playable_state_extension.observations: At most32 finite features: existing seven scalar fields plus declared actual maze, RPG or farming state projections, including action prerequisites, plot growth and resources; no hidden reward, learned world model or inferred commercial-game semantics.
playable_state_extension.visuals: Bounded original PNG scene projection of actual maze cells/player/key/exit, farm plots/crops/moisture and RPG party/quest/resources; other engines retain honest telemetry. Source-session and state digests bind frame evidence.
playable_state_extension.replay: Snapshot retains every bounded attempted action; accepted commands alone enter canonical underlying engine replay. Restore independently executes the complete attempt ledger, including rejected transitions, before adopting any state.
playable_state_extension.compatibility: Exact adapter/frame implementation and environment identities change. Previously issued snapshots are never silently transformed or relabelled as current numerical evidence.
playable_state_extension.automation: Existing same-owner job fences, source authority, actor IPC and compute-credit leases remain unchanged. No new scheduler, store or provider boundary.
playable_state_extension.diagnostics: Existing product diagnostic accepts only source-bound original scene PNG with valid bytes/dimensions and false native/hardware framebuffer claims, or the existing clearly labelled scalar telemetry. This reconciliation adds no automated test suite or execution.

ai_rule_variation.interface: AI model supplies bounded declarative source-specific rules; typed original-game editor and scene validators authenticate changes, no arbitrary executable source.
ai_rule_variation.evaluation: Single scenario-conditioned GamePolicyLearner, disjoint heldout scenario seeds, parent policy baseline, replay receipts. Current studio campaign also supports bounded typed rule mutations in its existing champion/adversarial evaluation.
ai_rule_variation.production: Training-derived candidate policy and optional replay-verifiable corpus only; real attested neural checkpoint required for separate candidate neural optimization and independent acceptance.
hard_limits: no arbitrary code, filesystem, network or provider invocation
no rule/policy promotion without separate authorization
ai_rule_variation.verification: Not yet passed exact-head runtime tests, security and benchmark review.

isolated_worker_request.fixed_environment_identity: source_digest + rule_plan_digest + gameplay implementation digest + rule executor source digest
isolated_worker_request.note: Current local CLI instantiates the same typed request; the existing parallel worker supports this kind, but no worker run was executed in this conversation.

advanced_scenario_lab.registration: All 43 original-game studio reference families have source-bound manifests; scenarios are independently executed via the canonical StudioGameEnvironment.

concurrent_viewer.scope: authenticated owner's read-only spectator simulations of current champion source
concurrent_viewer.caution: sampled telemetry, not actual training-episode frames, native renderer or live weights

generator.evidence: committed scoped campaign rounds, canonical editor limits, source integrity
generator.self_learning: Governed campaign evaluates and retains candidate rule mutations via existing measured Q-training and acceptance gates; optional CLI trains scenario-conditioned candidate Q policy with replay-verified neural corpus

exhaustive_test_plan.limitations: Declarative coverage, not tests already executed or exhaustive Cartesian world-space proof

ranked_research.permitted: factually cited popularity reference plus original abstract mechanics hypotheses only
ranked_research.forbidden: commercial assets, levels, dialogue, copied source, unauthorized proprietary training data

executable_engine_probes.evidence: each original registered command tested independently from reset, same-seed source replay and verified snapshot; accepted/rejected differentiated
executable_engine_probes.completion: not certified, check pages and native/genre/e2e quality gates remain required

concurrent_training_campaign.scope: Studio-only independent candidate/champion ordinary and adversarial evaluation uses bounded four-thread executor; six additional source-matched mirror perspectives independently measure declared rule changes.
concurrent_training_campaign.acceptance: worst observed mirror reward delta must satisfy configured worst-seed regression bound; no automatic live model weight promotion
concurrent_training_campaign.caveat: Actual measured round-frame stream not yet wired to the spectator preview; those frames remain separate.

effective_learning.budgets: pre-admit up to twelve auxiliary source-mirror episodes per changed-rule candidate per round; actual executed steps checked before committing
effective_learning.scenario_efficiency: bounded local parameter perturbations with canonical source digests and exclusion of previously explored committed settings
effective_learning.limitations: not proof of neural generalization, human creative quality, model training completion or hardware frame rates

candidate_trainer.behavior: scenario-balanced measured Q-policy sweeps; early-stop on two full entirely nonproductive sweeps, after all scenarios seen twice
candidate_trainer.neural_corpus: select most productive observed training trace per source scenario, rebuild source-authoritative examples, no heldout contamination or automatic model promotion
candidate_trainer.verification: unexecuted regression test cases included; not a successful checkpoint model training claim

ten_run_multispectral.candidate_training: ten actual source-game Q policy episodes prioritized using ten source-audited exploratory mirrors; three independent heldout seeds; consent and rights required; no automatic production promotion
ten_run_multispectral.independent_test_verification: not verified; new tests committed but not executed

shadow_saturation.ten_rule: Ten consecutive independently audited zero-learning cycles *after* the most recent novel original-game behavior or significant Q-policy gain, per parent simulation
shadow_saturation.shadow_clones: Exact parent intermediate snapshot is restored in an isolated engine and branched using an alternate registered action, then independently replayed and verified
shadow_saturation.policy_training: optional local real GamePolicyLearner Q episodes per cycle with new visited state-action pairs and source-measured maximum Q delta (default tolerance 1e-4) governing convergence
shadow_saturation.peak_scrutiny: 20 multispectral baseline checks per parent-plus-clone cycle, escalating by one independent extra check each successive cycle to a peak of 28; repeated at peak
shadow_saturation.evidence: SHA256 receipt chain with full per-step evidence for both branches, original and shadow checkpoint digests, reverse replay, spectral proofs, exact source/Q update counts, measured novelty and budget usage
shadow_saturation.persistence: exclusive append-only fsync-per-cycle JSONL ledger with independent final certificate only on completed verified run
shadow_saturation.resources: max 64 cycles per parent, max 12 steps per simulation, 4 concurrent threads, finite replay-work budget; an exhausted budget MUST report unproven
shadow_saturation.verification: focused tests committed; not run at exact head

multifactor_training.coverage: up to 8 executable axes per source bank and 512 bounded candidate worlds for greedy pair/three-way covering
multifactor_training.real_execution: Only runtime-declared settings and approved action palette. All absent controls report unimplemented_for_this_engine.
measurements: base vs joint on identical seed
multifactor_training.default_training: 3 source-matched local-Q episodes per selected combo (operator rights admission required), 2 disjoint heldout seeds; up to 8 combos
multifactor_training.independent_neural: Only independently replayed, operator-SHA-pinned training data can enter an existing checkpoint candidate optimizer, not automatic model promotion

factorial_scrutiny.execution: complete 2^k factorial source-game intervention lattice for k=2 or 3 selected active axes, each on 2 or 3 disjoint seeds; original registered actions and source-validated settings only
factorial_scrutiny.per_corner: ten-pass independently replayed multispectral audit, complete original-game action/observation/reward/transition receipts
factorial_scrutiny.reverse: re-execute fully modified and unmodified worlds in reverse execution order on each tested seed and reject divergent receipts
factorial_scrutiny.action_order: replay genuine reverse command sequences on matching world/seed and record reward, action acceptance and state-trajectory differences
factorial_scrutiny.effects: exact signed main, pair and triple inclusion/exclusion contrasts with per-seed mean, worst, min/max, spread and sign-reversal evidence
factorial_scrutiny.risk_queue: bounded ordered source-derived reasons and proposed seeds; no automatically scheduled or executed followup
factorial_scrutiny.parameter_scrutiny: signed Q-value deltas, positive/negative counts, absolute drift quantiles p50/p90/p99, top 96 sampled state-action before/after changes, per-action weight movement, full Q snapshot digest
factorial_scrutiny.viewer: Jeeves panel displays factorial coverage, order effects, adversarial followup recommendations
claims_excluded: statistical significance with two or three seeds
factorial_scrutiny.verification: tests added; exact-head CI and integration not yet complete

shared_compute_admission.capacity_owner: existing workspace.workers canonical CPU training_credit_ids from core.game_play.resource_profiles; no separate resource pool
shared_compute_admission.busy_behavior: Immediate bounded capacity-busy response; no queued executor work before physical credit admission
shared_compute_admission.cancellation: Shield the raw executor future and drain it across repeated caller cancellation; keep credit and heartbeat until physical thread and any bounded internal executor have quiesced
shared_compute_admission.failure_scope: Lease/heartbeat loss requests cooperative cancellation and rejects publication after finite work drains. Pure helpers without cancellation hooks finish their existing bounded work; no force-kill or cross-replica exclusion guarantee during a remote storage outage.
shared_compute_admission.publication: No training-state writes or model promotion; only existing capacity-control rows are leased and released.
shared_compute_admission.current_source_authority: Campaign-bound endpoints recheck current scoped source and teacher rights after physical compute before publishing; captured cursor, seed and source receipts retain their original identities.
